name: Full-Stack Developer (AI), Severa
description:
We want you to shine! Severa   is the market-leading SaaS solution for professional services organisations, serving around 50,000 users in Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and the Netherlands. With Severa our customers can manage projects and resources as well as time tracking and invoicing processes. Our goal is to grow our presence in the Nordic market and become the most beloved tool for project teams. We are now looking for a Full-Stack Developer (AI) to lead the development of AI-powered features in our product. What will you be doing? You will play a key role in developing AI features for our product, working across the full stack - from concept and UI to backend APIs and automation. You'll plan and implement the right approach for each use case, whether that's an LLM-powered feature, a predictive ML model, or something entirely new. This includes collaborating closely with our product management team on roadmap planning and technical decisions, as well as ensuring the features you build run reliably in production. Looking ahead, we're also building out a Data Lake, which will open up exciting new possibilities for the AI/ML services you can build on top of it. What are we looking for?

Several years of experience in software development, with a proven track record of building and shipping full-stack projects into production.
Solid hands-on experience with C# .NET and React / TypeScript.
Practical, hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered features to production - using LLM platforms such as Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI (or equivalent), whether in a professional or significant personal project.
Strong programming skills, with hands-on experience working in an AI-first development pipeline - using agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of your day-to-day workflow.
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on complex technical issues and a proactive approach to new challenges.
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform - Azure experience is a strong plus, but equivalent AWS/GCP experience is fine.
Excellent communication skills in English, which is our working language.

Bonus points if you have experience in:

Engineering prompts and evaluating LLM output quality and reliability in production
Working with MCP or similar tool-calling and agent architectures
Implementing vector databases and RAG patterns
Balancing AI cost/latency trade-offs (model selection, caching, token optimization)
Exposure to data lake / data platform technologies (e.g. Microsoft Fabric) - an area we're actively expanding into
Setting up AI observability to track model performance, drift, or usage in production

What to expect when joining us? When you join our Severa R&D team, you are stepping into a forward-thinking environment where AI is integrated into the core of our development lifecycle. We are committed to an AI-first approach, moving GenAI from exploratory projects to production-ready workflows. In this role, you will:

Drive AI Innovation: You'll take features from discovery to deployment using our AI-aided development pipeline, with real ownership over how AI is applied to solve customer problems - not just implementing a spec.
Work in a Cohesive, Autonomous Environment: You'll join a small, cross-functional feature team (3-5 people) with end-to-end technical responsibility - backed by a dedicated Team Manager and Product Owner, so you can focus on shipping rather than navigating the process.
Collaborate and Grow: You'll join our AI Champions network and share knowledge with fellow developers through our developer guilds, in a culture built on autonomy and continuous improvement as we scale across the Nordics.

Our product development organization consists of ~30 people. You'll belong to one of our feature teams, where you will work in close collaboration with other cross-functional product teams to translate product management team plans and visions into capability features. We want you to grow with us We are a committed, curious, and solution-oriented collective of team players. With us you'll have the autonomy and responsibility to drive our shared goals, backed by the mentorship of your leaders and the collective expertise of Visma's AI community. We provide opportunities for professional growth, learning new skills, and advancing your career. We have the opportunity to use 10% of our working hours to learn new things. With us, you'll undoubtedly build your own growth story. We want you to shine! At Visma Solutions you'll have a cosy and relaxed work environment with over 500 colleagues, modern tools, and comprehensive  employee benefits  that support work-life balance. Visma Solutions Oy has been awarded the Hyvän mielen työpaikka® symbol as a recognition of commitment to strengthening the mental health of employees. The multinational corporation combined with the agile approach of Visma family companies creates a unique work environment and excellent career opportunities. Apply now! If this opportunity feels like your next step, send us your application by August 16th, 2026. Visma Solutions offices are in Helsinki and Lappeenranta, but you can also work from other Visma offices or remotely from anywhere in Finland. However, we hope to see you visit your team mates occasionally in our Helsinki office (Pasila, Mall of Tripla) or our Lappeenranta office (where a large part of our Severa R&D colleagues are based). Our recruitment process includes 2 interview rounds and we contact all candidates latest within a week after the application period has ended. We will start processing applications at the turn of July and August. As this is a new position, the salary range depends on your relevant experience and seniority, but we are happy to hear your expectations. Any questions? Please contact Development Leader Samuli Kenttämies at  samuli.kenttamies@visma.com  . Please note that Samuli is currently on vacation and will respond to inquiries upon his return, starting July 27th. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know in your application if you need any support. More than 500 top experts at Visma Solutions help our customers to improve and automate their business. Our products for financial administration, payroll, operational management, and electronic signature are market leaders in their respective fields. We are part of the agile Nordic software group Visma, which employs 1 500 experts in Finland. Read more at  https://www.visma.fi/yritykset/visma-solutions-oy  .Visma is a leading provider of mission-critical business software, with revenue of € 2.8 billion in 2025 and more than 2.4 million customers across Europe and Latin America. By simplifying and automating the work of SMBs and the public sector, we help unleash the power of digitalization and AI across our societies and economies. Think of Visma as an ecosystem of companies, cultures, and people, united by shared values and the vision to shape the future of society through technology. In Finland we already have 1450+ employees and serve more than 200 000 customers. Visit us at www.visma.com

name: Full Stack Developer - Technology EDM-team
description:
Haluatko rakentaa kestävämpää tulevaisuutta osana kokenutta tiimiämme? Enerim on johtava energia-alan järjestelmätoimittaja. Meissä yhdistyy kattava energia-alan asiantuntijuus ja tulevaisuuteen tähtäävä digitaalinen kehitystyö. SaaS-ratkaisujemme avulla digitalisoimme asiakkaidemme energiamarkkinaprosesseja, tehostamme ja uudistamme heidän liiketoimintaansa sekä tarjoamme kestäviä ja älykkäitä ratkaisuja tulevaisuuden energiamarkkinoiden tarpeisiin. Tarjoamme kiinnostavan näköalapaikan muuttuvan energia-alan ytimeen. Käynnissä oleva energiamurros mahdollistaa tulevaisuuden vähäpäästöisen yhteiskunnan, joka perustuu puhtaaseen energiaan, toimitusvarmoihin verkkoihin ja toimiviin energiamarkkinoihin. 
 Haemme EnerimEDM-mittaustiedonhallintajärjestelmän tuotekehitykseen kokenutta Full Stack -ohjelmistokehittäjää.  
Työskentelet keskeisessä roolissa kehittämässä Enerimin seuraavan sukupolven mittaustiedonhallintajärjestelmää yhdessä kokeneen tiimin kanssa. Suunnittelet ja toteutat skaalautuvan, moderniin arkkitehtuuriin pohjautuvan järjestelmän ominaisuuksia hyödyntäen mm. mikropalveluarkkitehtuuria ja moderneja rajapintoja. Kokemuksesi avulla pääset myös vaikuttamaan teknologisiin ratkaisuihin ja tiimin toimintamalleihin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä sisäisten ja ulkoisten sidosryhmiemme kanssa varmistaaksesi ratkaisujen vaatimustenmukaisuuden sekä laadukkaan, tehokkaan ja käyttäjäystävällisen toteutuksen.

Mittaustiedonhallintajärjestelmän ominaisuuksien suunnittelu, toteutus, testaus ja ylläpito huomioiden toiminnalliset ja ei-toiminnalliset vaatimukset

Ratkaisujen tekninen dokumentointi (mm. tuotekuvaukset, API-dokumentaatio)  


Odotukset osaamiselle: 


Syvällinen osaaminen backend-ohjelmistosuunnittelusta ja -kehityksestä (C#, .NET) 




Vahva osaaminen tietokannoista ja SQL-kehityksestä (esim. PostgreSQL) 




Vahva osaaminen rajapinnoista ja integraatioista (REST API, event-driven ja streaming-pohjaiset ratkaisut) 




Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuurista, skaalautuvista järjestelmistä ja pilvipohjaisista ratkaisuista 




Kokemusta WebUI-teknologioista 




Vahvat ongelmanratkaisutaidot ja analyyttinen ajattelu   




Hyvät viestintä- ja yhteistyötaidot suomen ja englannin kielellä 


Katsotaan eduksi: 


Kokemus suurten datamassojen tai aikasarjadatan käsittelystä  




Käytännön kokemus tekoälytyökaluista ja -ratkaisuista tuotekehityksen tukena sekä kokemus AI/ML-ratkaisuista 




Ruotsin kielen osaaminen    


Etsimme tiimiin sopivaa henkilöä ensisijaisesti Oulun seudulta, jossa tuotekehitystiimimme pääsääntöisesti sijaitsevat. Tarjoamme lisäksi joustavat etätyömahdollisuudet.   Lähetäthän hakemuksesi viimeistään 16.8.2026 mennessä oheisen hakulinkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten kannattaa hakea mahdollisimman pian, vaikka olisitkin jo kesälomatunnelmissa. 
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö kesä- ja elokuun aikana: Jari Markkanen, Head of Data Solutions & Delivery, jari.markkanen(at)enerim.com, +358 50 386 5642 
Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä innovatiivisessa ja eteenpäin katsovassa alan johtavassa yrityksessä. Pääset yhdessä loistavien asiantuntijoidemme, asiakkaidemme ja kumppaneidemme kanssa kehittämään liiketoimintakriittisiä järjestelmiä energiatoimialan ytimeen. Työn oheen tarjoamme muun muassa ePassin henkilöstöedut liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin, lounasedun sekä vakuutusturvan myös etätyöhön. name: IT Procurement Partner, Services and Business Solutions
description:
We are looking for an IT Procurement Partner to join the Corporate Procurement, Indirect Procurement team in Espoo or Stockholm.About the role The purpose of this role is to act as the strategic IT procurement partner for the Services and Business solutions area. The person in this role will lead procurement and SRM for the respective IT area and align sourcing priorities and outcomes with IT roadmap and digital growth objectives. You will manage selected IT categories and ensure value creation, performance and risk management across the area.The role combines close collaboration with IT, business and suppliers, and focuses on leading the procurement activities in a cross-functional virtual team rather than executing all tasks and sourcing cases personally.Main responsibilities:

Own procurement planning, performance and activities for the IT Services and Business solutions area
Create and implement relevant category strategies and translate IT roadmaps and demand into sourcing plans by providing commercial, contractual, and market perspectives
Act as the primary procurement interface for the Business IT Leadership team
Steer and manage the procurement execution through a virtual team and act as an escalation point when needed
Execute selected sourcing activities and drive adoption of new suppliers, contracts, and models
Ensure support for IT projects, including e.g. changes, claims and dispute prevention
Drive SRM activities and supplier performance management, including executive‑level engagement and effective issue resolution where needed
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, IT governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements
Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes and tools

About you To succeed and thrive in this role, we see that you have:

8-10 years of experience in IT procurement including category management
Strong understanding of IT procurement such as security, data privacy, managing complex legacy agreements, IT consulting, application services and project procurement
Experience on acting as the primary procurement interface to IT leadership teams and steering decisions with commercial and market insight
Proven track record of owning procurement planning, SRM and performance management for an IT area
Ability to translate business objectives and IT roadmaps into sourcing plans
Proven experience of leading virtual category team, and creating and implementing category strategies in the IT service area
Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence business decisions
Strong negotiation skills and the ability to communicate complex commercial topics clearly and in a business-friendly way
Fluency in English

We offer you A unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of business, IT and procurement, shaping how technology enables Fortum's growth.In this role, you will:

Build strong understanding of the energy business through close collaboration with IT and Business
Act as a strategic partner, influencing decisions with commercial insight
Lead through a virtual team, giving you broad leadership responsibility
Own your area with clear accountability for outcomes and value creation
Drive impactful sourcing decisions and supplier relationships
Contribute to developing procurement processes and ways of working

This is a role for someone who wants to combine commercial expertise with strategic influence and make a real impact on how technology is sourced and managed at Fortum.More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.Interested?Submit your application (CV) in English by July 26th, 2026 at the latest. The recruitment is on hold during the summer. We will begin actively screening after the application period has closed, and hire as soon as the right candidate is found.If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact Elina Haaparanta at elina.haaparanta@fortum.com. Please note that response times may be longer than usual due to the holiday season.We are FortumFortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best-in-class low-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum's power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi-validated emission reduction targets on our way towards net-zero by 2040. For our ~4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. name: Senior-pilvikehittäjä, Azure-pilvimigraatiot / .NET
description:
Kiinnostaako sinua kehittää .NET-sovelluksia Azure-pilviympäristössä ja olla mukana viemässä yhteiskunnan kannalta merkityksellisiä digipalveluja pilveen?
Etsimme senior-tason pilvikehittäjää vahvistamaan tiimejämme Azure-ympäristöissä tehtävään .NET-sovelluskehitykseen ja pilvimigraatioihin. Tässä roolissa pääset yhdistämään vahvan ohjelmistokehitystaustan, käytännön Azure-osaamisen sekä kokemuksen siitä, miten sovelluksia siirretään, modernisoidaan ja ylläpidetään pilviympäristössä.
Tässä roolissa pilvimigraatio-osaaminen on keskeinen edellytys tehtävässä onnistumiselle. Toivomme, että olet ollut mukana viemässä sovelluksia pilveen esimerkiksi suunnittelemalla migraatiota, toteuttamalla sovellus- tai ympäristömuutoksia, rakentamalla julkaisuputkia, varmistamalla sovellusten toimivuutta Azure-ympäristössä tai osallistumalla migraation jälkeiseen jatkokehitykseen.
Rooli ei ole puhdas infra- tai arkkitehtitehtävä, vaan ennen kaikkea käytännönläheinen senior-kehittäjän rooli. On kuitenkin tärkeää, että ymmärrät, miten .NET-sovellukset toimivat Azure-pilviympäristössä ja miten niitä siirretään hallitusti pilveen. Azure App Service, Windows-virtuaalikoneet, Azure DevOps -pipelinejen konfigurointi sekä .NET-sovellusten ajaminen näiden päällä ovat sinulle tuttuja. Terraform-osaaminen katsotaan eduksi, sillä infraa hallitaan sen avulla.
Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Toivomme, että sinulla on vahva ohjelmistokehitystausta ja kokemusta .NET-sovellusten kehittämisestä Azure-ympäristössä. Tässä tehtävässä erityisen tärkeää on, että pystyt osoittamaan aiempaa kokemusta sovellusten migroinnista pilveen.
Odotamme sinulta:


Useamman vuoden kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä senior-tasoisissa, erityisesti vahvaa kokemusta .NET-ympäristöstä ja C#-kehityksestä.


Ymmärrystä siitä, miten .NET-sovelluksia ajetaan, ylläpidetään ja kehitetään Azure App Servicen ja Windows-virtuaalikoneiden päällä.


Käytännön kokemusta Azure-pilviympäristöstä.


Todennettavaa kokemusta sovellusten migraatioista pilveen.


Azure DevOps -osaamista, erityisesti pipelinejen konfiguroinnista ja CI/CD-käytännöistä.


Kokemusta Terraformista tai muista Infrastructure as Code -työkaluista.


Kykyä hahmottaa sovellusten toimintaa, integraatioita, julkaisuputkia ja tuotantoympäristöjen kokonaisuuksia.


Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja.


Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.


Katsomme eduksi, jos sinulla on kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista:


Azure Application Insights tai muut Azuren valvonta- ja diagnostiikkapalvelut.


Sovellusten modernisointi migraation yhteydessä.


React, Blazor tai muu frontend-teknologia.


MS SQL, T-SQL, Entity Framework tai tietokantojen optimointi.


RabbitMQ tai muut integraatio- ja viestinvälitysratkaisut.


Sertifioitu Azure-osaaminen tai halukkuus suorittaa Azure-sertifikaatti työnantajan tuella.


Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto.


Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Palkka muodostuu roolisi ja osaamisesi mukaisesti yhdessä keskustellen ja käytössäsi on kattavat edut. Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle jotain ainutlaatuista:


Hakkeruus: Uteliaisuus ja rohkeus kokeilla uutta ovat toimintamme ytimessä. Tuemme osaamistasi koulutusbonusten ja henkilökohtaisen urasparrauksen avulla.


Vapaus ja vastuu: Ohjaat itse omaa työelämääsi ja vaikutat yhteiseen matkaamme. Mahdollisuudet ovat laajat ja kasvavat koko ajan, erityisesti datatalouden kentällä.


Palkittu kulttuuri: Olemme useaan otteeseen sijoittuneet Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa kärkisijoille, ja saimme ykkössijan vuonna 2020. Arvojemme mukainen toiminta on meille ensiarvoisen tärkeää.


Mahtava tiimi: Meillä työskentelemme tiimeissä, eikä yksinäisiä susia ole. Järjestämme monia yhteisiä vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, ja kollegoista tulee helposti ystäviä.


Joustavuus: Tarjoamme paikkariippumattoman ja joustavan työkulttuurin, joka mahdollistaa elämän eri vaiheet, kuten jatko-opinnot tai perhevapaan.


Lue lisää Alfamesta työpaikkana täältä.
Hakuprosessi
Esittäydy meille CV:n kera verkkosivujemme hakulomakkeen kautta. Kerrothan myös ajatuksesi sinulle sopivasta palkkahaarukasta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi kesällä ja aloitamme haastattelut lomien jälkeen elokuussa. Kaikki tapaamiset hoituvat toiveidesi mukaan etänä tai livenä:


Keskustelu Talent Acquisition Manager Susanna Huhmarniemen sekä teknisen rekrytointivastaavan kanssa (Helsinki / Tampere / etä)


Tapaaminen tulevien työkavereiden kanssa (Helsinki / Tampere / Kokkola / Rovaniemi / etä)


Sopimusasiat HR:n kanssa (Helsinki / etä)

name: Senior Software Developer, Vantaa or Malaga
description:
Creating more room for life. Together.

name: Senior IT Developer for Settlement
description: Job ID: 1040 Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy. We are looking for a Senior Calypso Developer to join our team developing components powering one of core processes in the trading business - Settlement. This is a permanent and full-time position, based in our office in Helsinki (Finland). Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We’re not just a bank; we’re a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry. About our team Meet the Settlement Development team. Our role is to develop and modernize integrations of Calypso - our modern Settlement system with the rest of the bank’s IT landscape. Besides the 4 scrum teams developing the platform, there are a development support team and a maintenance team. This way the development teams can focus on delivering high quality solutions. Calypso is a central piece of Nordea’s trading lifecycle and supports settlement of bonds and equities. Our team’s main focus is on expanding business logic of Calypso and on surrounding microservices. Responsibilities for this position include both integrating vendor upgrades and enhancing functionality, specifically adding support of new flows. Currently, our Calypso installation is on the path of expanding scope to process settlement of bonds and equities in all Nordea markets.  Main responsibilities in this role:Designing and coding robust, well-tested, clean solutions using latest tools and technologyDeveloping in and around a complex off the shelf platform Calypso – creating code, which smoothly integrates with the Calypso enginePerforming code reviews and work with developer colleagues in continuously improving quality and clean coding practicesClosely collaborating with product owners, business experts, IT Analysts, Developers, testers and Scrum Masters and take an active part in agile ceremoniesParticipating in our technology communities - dev days, innovation sprints and day to day Who you are  This is the right role for you if you are a skilled Calypso and Java developer with 6+ years of experience, are fluent in English and have good interpersonal skills in dealing with technical and business stakeholders. And you own problems whether you know the solution or not – if the latter, you are not afraid to ask questions and seek answers. Finally, you have a sense of humour and strive in multinational environment. Your background and skills include:Knowledge and experience of Calypso platform, preferably supporting settlement of securities (bonds, equities)Understand how to define and design good test coverage including negative testsPractical experience in using some of tools and technologies below – or similar:Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShiftGit, BitBucket, SonarQube, Splunk, BambooConfluence, JiraExperience or desire to learn to build and maintain integrations with off-the-shelf software in the enterprise setup It would be ideal if you also have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or similar. What we offer Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward. A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment. Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility. Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving. If this sounds like you, get in touch!  Next steps ​Submit your application no later than 07/08/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Zbigniew Piotrowski at zbigniew.piotrowski@nordea.com. Please note that due to the summer period, we will begin reviewing applications at the beginning of August. We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good. We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates. We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges. We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy. We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us. Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. If you are an external consultant interested in this role and wish to apply please contact the hiring people leader for separate instruction on how to apply. A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.
